literal: Themselves that which brings joy, the world rejoicing having seen, they will desire, having learned those who know.
translation: Seeing the world rejoice in the very learning that brings them joy, the wise will love learning all the more.
modern: தாம் இன்பம் அடையும் கல்வியால் உலகமும் இன்பம் அடைவதைப் பார்த்து, கற்றறிந்த அறிஞர்கள் அக்கல்வியின் மீது மேலும் விருப்பம் கொள்வார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet explains the self-reinforcing nature of learning. The learned find immense personal joy in their knowledge. When they share this knowledge and see the world also rejoicing in it, their love for learning deepens. The word 'காமுறுவர்' (they will desire or love) shows that the pursuit of knowledge becomes a passionate, lifelong endeavor driven by both personal fulfillment and the joy it brings to others.
